about: What each clip is, for the screen: the weapon family of the hand and the id the kernel or the content already gives the move. `none-yet` where no id exists; no id is invented here. A variant may override the motion's entry: the key `motion/variant`, or `motion/<variant's first word>` (so every `side-...` take of fell reads `fell/side`).

sources.hit: kernel/src/fight.ts event `{ e: 'hit', by: 'foe' }` (the player taking a hit; `stagger` follows on a guard); COMBAT.md 4.2
sources.fell: content/core/professions/woodcutting.json profession.verb; its `techniques` list is empty, so a second kind of felling has no id yet
sources.tech: FightInput `tech` takes a technique id from a school's active slot; no combat technique exists in content/core/schools yet
sources.dig: kernel/src/step.ts Action `{ t: 'dig', spot, grade, at }`; content/core/professions/digging.json profession.verb 'dig'
